$comment: The minimap and the explored-world map (docs/adr/0068-minimap-and-explored-map.md; owner, 2026-11-08). minimap: radiusM (the disc's reach, m), texelM (metres a texel), sizePx (its CSS size), compactSizePx on a screen whose short side is less than compactBelowPx (a phone either way up: the full size covered the touch look area sideways and the hotbar and status lines upright), moveTexels and turnDegrees (the disc is drawn again only when the player has moved this many texels or turned this far), refreshSeconds (the terrain under it is read again this often, for edits), scanUpM and scanDownM (how far above and below the eye a column's top is looked for), playerColor (the red dot), otherColor (other players' dots), dotPx (a dot's size), edgeColor (the ring), cpuUpdateMs (the CPU adapter's tier: on a software renderer the minimap and its dots are brought up to date at most this often, ms). heightShading: the toggle's default (Settings, On screen: the minimap in the big map's height colours instead of its blocks' colours, to compare), waterDepthM (the minimap's scan follows water down this far: its blocks' colour darkens to its deepest over it and its height colours read the depth to here). heightTint (the big map's look always, the minimap's when heightShading is on; owner, 2026-11-09: block colours "lightly tinted by height", after the 0.50.53 height bands hid the sand): each cell its block colour scaled in brightness by its height above sea level, darkest at or below lowM, brightest at or above highM, linear between (water keeps its colour, already darkened by its depth). explored: cellM (a coarse cell is explored once its centre is within the minimap's radius of the player, a 2D distance on their face, whatever the height and whether its terrain is loaded), pendingColor (an explored cell's colour until the loaded terrain or the generator gives it one). bigMap: levels (owner, 2026-11-09: "at most 5 zoom levels", the closest "the mini map size", the widest "the entire world/island"; 2–5 of them, closest first): each level's cellM (a map cell's side, m: its own detail, a whole power of two, rising; 1 m a cell up close), the span each shows across the panel's short side computed by the generator (the closest the minimap's diameter, the widest the island's, shared/protocol/constants.json, the rest spaced geometrically between), startLevel (the level the map opens at, 0 the closest), wheelStepPx (the scroll that steps one level), pinchStep (the pinch spread or squeeze that steps one level), fogColor (unexplored), and the panel it is drawn in (owner, 2026-11-09): panelFraction (its share of the screen's width and height, the game showing round it), phoneMarginPx (its margin inside the safe area on a screen whose short side is under minimap.compactBelowPx, where it is nearly full screen), buttonPx and phoneButtonPx (the close, zoom and centre buttons' size), scaleBarMaxPx (the scale bar's longest; its length a 1, 2 or 5 times ten metres), frameColor (its title bar and frame), padPanPxPerS (the controller's stick or D-pad pans this many pixels a second at full tilt), and the controller's buttons on the open map (shared/input/gamepad.json's names): padZoomIn, padZoomInAlt, padZoomOut, padZoomOutAlt (a press steps one level), padCenter, padClose (View closes it too). revealed (the map's tiles, every level's, generated from the terrain generator in the job workers and kept per world and build in this browser, IndexedDB dwell-map-tiles, so each is built once; in a mode with the mapRevealed ability, creative, nothing is fogged, elsewhere unexplored ground is): tileCells (a tile is this many cells of its level a side, generated as one job), jobsInFlight (at most this many tiles generating at once for the open map, so chunk streaming keeps its workers), backgroundJobs (at most this many building in the background while the map is shut or its view is whole), prebuildSpans (the background builds each level's tiles within this many of its spans round the player, the widest level's the whole island), budgetMs (the most a frame spends taking finished tiles), redrawMs (the open map is drawn again at most this often while tiles arrive). Run `node shared/ui/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/map.gen.rs or client/src/ui/map.gen.ts is stale.
